_instructions_DO_NOT_EDIT: START HERE. This portable example is safe to copy; do not put machine-local values in the checked-in example.

Edit only value members inside _operator_inputs_EDIT in your local copy. The adjacent _comment members explain each value and must not be edited. The workflow creates the job ID from episode and confirmed_title; do not supply one.
Confirm the Archive item, episode/title, DVD mode, and cut-PAD choice for your job; do not reuse these sample decisions blindly.

DVD mode choices: use a DVD-backed plan with --dvd <exact matching DVD path>, or choose --no-dvd explicitly. No-DVD mode has no DVD-derived 5.1/SRT and cannot pass external absolute A/V correlation; it uses the separate LD-only duration/PAD timing route.
The workflow app generates an initialize command that matches the selected DVD mode; always preview the generated plan before execution.

For no-DVD jobs, cut_pad_images choices are use or skip when shared stills are available. use permits a uniquely verified still only for a confirmed cut-PAD frame; skip forbids those stills, so later cut-PAD repair must use the documented hold-cut method. Neither choice permits cross-shot RIFE.
The intake ends after input validation. Review the initialized manifest's title/identity before creating a processing plan.
For shared mode, resolve the device episode workspace first and set manifest_path to that workspace's manifest/SxxExx.json.
The runner fills approved_by from the current local account and approved_at_utc from the workflow start time; do not enter either value.

episode._comment: Required. SxxExx code confirmed against the selected Archive item.

profile._comment: Required. Absolute path to this machine's external device-local machine profile.

archive_url._comment: Required. Confirmed Archive item URL; its episode identity must match episode above.

downloads_dir._comment: Required. Exact intended download folder on a volume with sufficient free space.

confirmed_title._comment: Required audit choice. Confirm from the DVD/capture evidence; after initialization, verify the manifest title matches.

dvd_mode._comment: Required choice: DVD-backed (requires the exact matching DVD path) or no-dvd (must be explicit). No-DVD means LD-only timing, no DVD 5.1/SRT, and no external absolute A/V correlation.

cut_pad_images._comment: No-DVD choice when shared cut-PAD stills are available: use allows a curated, uniquely matched still only for a confirmed cut-PAD; skip forbids stills and uses hold-cut. Stills never replace a DVD reference or other video/audio.

manifest_path._comment: Required. Absolute expected manifest path. In shared mode, resolve the device episode workspace and use its manifest folder.
